title: Limited Life Replica
description: A Limited Life datapack that you can play with your friends. Features a countdown above your hotbar, Boogeyman selection, losing time whenever you die and getting set to spectator when you run out of time.
body:
This is a datapack that replicates Grian's Limited Life series so that you can play it with your friends. The datapack features a countdown next to your hotbar, random boogeyman selection, losing an hour whenever you die and automatically getting set to spectator mode when you run out of time.

Start the datapack with the command _/trigger start_
Pick a boogeyman with _/trigger boogeyman_
If you think 24 hours is too long, you can select a custom starting time with _/trigger start set (time in game ticks)_

You can watch a similar explanation of the datapack here: https://youtube/Hhdi4p8ix2M

Disclaimer: This is not my idea. All credit goes to Grian for the Limited Life concept.
